speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
text: asked	the Minister for Defence (a) what are the forms of assistance schemes available to National Servicemen who suffer a recurrence of injuries sustained during his service period; and (b) whether there is a limit set in terms of the amounts and tenures.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: We make every effort to minimise the risk of injury during service.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: Additional amounts are also provided for total permanent disability.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: Other forms of assistance schemes available to National Servicemen include the SAF Benevolent Fund and the SAF Care Fund, which provide welfare support to injured Servicemen and their families.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: The amounts disbursed are based on the financial circumstances and needs of these Servicemen.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: Two grants are provided under the SAF Benevolent Fund.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: They are the Benevolent Grant and the Welfare Benevolent Grant.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: Depending on the Servicemen's circumstances, additional assistance for education and medical needs may also be provided.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: Eligibility for the Welfare Benevolent Grant is re-assessed every two years and we do not set a limit on the number of renewals.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: Two other grants are also provided under the SAF Care Fund.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: They are the Helping Hand Grant and the Care Support Grant.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: Eligibility for the Care Support Grant is re-assessed every three years and we do not set a limit on the number of renewals.
